name: WOT pull + over-temperature marks (generic OBD-II)
description: Records wide-open-throttle pulls from the SAE J1979 mode-01 channels and marks coolant over-temperature. Channel ids list the loggers/obd2-mode01.json id first and the `opentune obd read` key second, so the file works with both. Use: opentune obd read --driver <id> --rounds 0 --out pulls.csv --trigger packs/generic-obd2/triggers/wot-pull.json --split 0C 11 05

triggers.name: wot-pull
triggers.description: Engine speed (PID 0x0C) above 3000 rpm with throttle position (PID 0x11) above 90 % for 300 ms. Released after 1 s below either threshold; keeps 3 s before the fire and 5 s after the release.

triggers.name: coolant-hot
triggers.description: Coolant temperature (PID 0x05) above 105 °C for 1 s; re-arms after 5 s below.
